notes.title: Build 1.005 is Live
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24006732/7835a88863d3a4f69653fe0d535e3d8bc520d494.png

Hey all,

We have a fix for what was reported this week: 

What in this update?
- The achievement upon completing all others should now correctly be awarded. If you already unlocked all other achievements, this one should be awarded when simply booting the game. 
- A fix for platforms that are reacting to enemies in earlier puzzles in world 6.
- The special achievement for world 5 has been made slightly more forgiving.

Known Issues:
- Steam Cloud doesn't work for OS X, due to the + character. 

As always, do let us know in if you're running into anything else!

Cheers :)

notes.title: Build 1.003 is Live
notes.content:
Hey all,

What in this update?

Known Issues:
- Steam Cloud doesn't work for OS X, due to the + character. We're investigating if a workaround is possible, but didn't want to let Windows players wait for it. 


Let us know in if you're running into anything else!

Cheers :)

notes.title: Thanks for all the positive responses to Metrico!
notes.content:
Hey all,

We are very glad so many of you have been exploring the world of Metrico. The responses have been very positive, which is great for the team.

We are also happy with the complete absence of bug reports so far. We will continue to update the build whenever there are things we want to fix. If you do find a bug please send it in, because we want every player to have the best experience possible, and we'd be happy to fix it. 


We just did a quick fix for what was found earlier today: 

1.003 update:
- The 'Help Animation' at the start of world 5 should now be working as intended when playing with the mouse (and keyboard). 

Known Issues:
- Steam Cloud doesn't work for OS X, due to the + character. We're investigating if a workaround is possible, but didn't want to let Windows players wait for it. 


Let us know in if you're running into anything else!

Have fun exploring Metrico!

notes.title: Build 1.002 is Live
notes.content:
Hello fellow explorers!

We´re not really getting any bug reports from you, which is of course a really good sign, but we figured there would have to be some thing that end up going wrong, and now we don't really know what to do ;) 

We did find one thing today that we really wanted to fix asap: 

What in this update?
- A fix concerning the final sequence; The doors may have been open for some players while entering the last section, resulting in an unintended shortcut of the last bit of the experience, and as a result preventing something from being possible that we won't spoil here. 
- Also fixed that the Restart World button in the pauze menu is really only visible when intended.

Known Issues:
- Steam Cloud doesn't work for OS X, due to the + character. We're investigating if a workaround is possible, but didn't want to let Windows players wait for it. 
- Achievements may not appear in your activity feed. We suspect it is because they're all hidden.



Let us know in if you're running into anything! We want to make sure everyone has a nice and smooth experience! 

Cheers :)

notes.title: Metrico+ is out now!
notes.content:
When we started Digital Dreams we were just 3 guys making stuff that we loved. We’re incredibly grateful that Sony picked us up ~4 years ago. Back then we didn’t even know yet what the world of Metrico would look like and how it would work. All we had was this scruffy prototype, but Sony had faith in us and the game, and helped making it into an actual game that is coming out today on PlayStation 4 and Steam.

Watch the Metrico+ release trailer here!

Making it big
Like so many of you, we grew up with some awe-inspiring games. We’ve had so many fantastic games and experiences that we will never forget: games like Rez, Metal Gear Solid, Journey or Shadow of the Colossus are just a few of a very long list of games that made a big impression on us. It’s what inspired us to start a company with one goal in mind: make original game experiences no one ever experienced before. When looking back, now that our studio has released our first game on Steam and PlayStation 4 (and Xbox One pending), we can honestly say this is a dream coming true.

Our personal journeys
While working on Metrico+, we obviously experienced a lot personally as well. Lots of things changed for us in the meantime: Relationships came and went, we had to move offices and homes and we all grew a little older and wiser.

The company changed as well. We worked with lots of different people to make Metrico+ possible. Most moved out when their work was finished, some stayed, but all had one thing in common: We all became close friends. As game developers, particularly on lengthy projects such as Metrico+, all of these personal endeavours become part of the experience you’re creating. It’s this weird symbiosiss between your personal and professional lives that is difficult to put into words. It’s what makes it so difficult but also satisfying to release a game.

This is for the Players
Anyway, without sounding too cheesy, we can honestly say the players are the reason why we can make these original games. We can’t wait to show you the next world that we’re creating. But for now, we really hope you enjoy the quirky world that is Metrico+.

Thank you very, very much for your interest

<333,
Geert, Roy & Thijmen here at Digital Dreams

notes.title: Metrico+ Comes to Steam on August 23!
notes.content:
Metrico+ has a release date, and it's due only 3 weeks from now!

TL;DR
Metrico+ will be available on the 23rd of August on the Steam for $13,99 / €13,99.


Metrico+´s timeline in a nutshell
With 3,5 years of each of our lives dedicated to Metrico+, we feel we're finally ready to share this very special world of infographics with you. We've tested the game through and through, with the help of a few hundred people here on Steam, to whom we're very thankful, and the game feels really solid. 

We'd also like take this opportunity to thank Enzo and his friends at the Steam Translator Lounge, who made sure everyone is able to understand what the game is about, in their own language here on the store page. 


Only 3 more weeks, during which we'll be making sure everyone's experience will be as smooth as possible, while also try and relax a little after last months' crunching period. We've used the beta forum up to now, but will start populating the general forums to answer any questions you may have. 

We hope you're looking much forward to playing, as we are to hearing your reactions and thoughts.


Thank you for taking an interest in our work, 
The very proud team at Digital Dreams

notes.title: Welcome to the Metrico+ Steam page!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

WELCOME TO METRICO+!
We're extremely excited to introduce all of you to the world of Metrico. The Steam page and Steam forum for Metrico+ is now live. Please share the news with everybody and follow Metrico+!

CLOSED BETA
We're having a closed beta right now in which we'd love to get everybody's feedback on the game. (The only way right now to get an invite to the closed beta is when you've played the game at an event where Metrico+ was showcased and got a wristband with an exclusive invite code.)

We're working extremely hard on implementing the last features, adding content and bug-fixing and polishing Metrico+. The release will follow soon after :)

If you have any thoughts, please let us know!


Thanks!
Digital Dreams..
